snapshot.name: Packrift Packaging Taxonomy Atlas

pricing.details: Public reference pages and data files are free to access.

endpoints.name: Homepage
endpoints.response_description: HTML overview with taxonomy counts, primary browse routes, public source boundaries, and sample Packrift SKU records.

endpoints.name: Stats JSON
endpoints.description: Machine-readable atlas counts and source policy.
endpoints.response_description: JSON object with generated timestamp, public source policy, SKU count, family count, tag count, and conservative claim boundaries.

endpoints.name: Taxonomy JSON
endpoints.description: Complete public taxonomy records for approved Packrift catalog rows.
endpoints.response_description: JSON dataset containing public SKU identifiers, product URLs, family labels, product types, tags, price bands, inventory bands, weight bands, and dimension bands.

endpoints.name: Sitemap
endpoints.description: Crawlable XML sitemap for all public atlas URLs.
endpoints.response_description: XML sitemap listing Packrift taxonomy HTML pages, data files, metadata files, manifest routes, and discovery sidecars.
